historical_implementation.initial_grid: all walls with only odd/odd logical cells opened
historical_implementation.defect: no passages were opened between adjacent logical cells, so every multi-cell result was disconnected
historical_implementation.rng: std::mt19937 seeded from time(nullptr), vector materialization plus shuffle for each wall and gap
historical_implementation.failure_contract: allocation and blocked-cell insertion failures were not reported

correction.initial_grid: open interior with a blocked one-cell perimeter
correction.division: insert one complete even-coordinate wall and retain exactly one odd-coordinate passage
correction.rng: shared Maze PCG32 generation context using bounded draws
correction.failure_contract: status propagation, cancellation polling, step limits, and failure-atomic output

region_contract.bounds: inclusive [left,right] by [top,bottom] raster coordinates with even boundary coordinates
region_contract.termination: stop when either span is less than 4 raster units
region_contract.orientation: split the longer span; square ties consume one bounded binary draw
region_contract.wall: uniform interior even coordinate at least 2 units from both parallel boundaries
region_contract.gap: uniform odd coordinate strictly inside the perpendicular boundaries
region_contract.empty_selection: unreachable because every active region has both spans at least 4
region_contract.maximum_depth_bound: at most logical_width plus logical_height minus 3 active divisions on one path

topology_proof.leaf: a terminal region has one logical row or one logical column and is an open path
topology_proof.induction: each split joins two recursively connected acyclic child regions through exactly one passage
topology_proof.result: the corrected logical passage graph is connected and acyclic, hence a perfect Maze

topology_oracle.extents: every odd width and height from 3 through 11
requirements: all odd/odd logical cells are passages
edge count equals logical node count minus one

consumer_inventory.generic_dispatcher: BYUL_MAZE_ALGORITHM_RECURSIVE_DIVISION routes to the internal generator

stage2_decision.region_stack: replace direct recursion with an explicit LIFO region stack while preserving child processing and RNG order
